title: 31-club injury x club-depth-chart join (derived)
why_derived: The NFL publishes no league-wide depth chart, so a depth rank can only come from the club's own chart. Clubs label those charts unofficial, so every row here is a club self-report joined to a league-published injury status.

sources.depth: each row carries its own club chart URL in club_chart_url

rows.injury: Knee, Not injury related - resting player

unmatched.why: player not listed on his club's depth chart
